about_the_game:
YASUKE: A Lost Descendant is a kinetic 3D anime action game where you strike with purpose and move with style. Play as Tanaka Yasuke, a young hero discovering his legacy as the heir to the legendary African samurai. Battle across the futuristic nation of N10N-KOKU using high-velocity parkour, dynamic swordplay, and supernatural power.

SLASH WITH STYLE

Express your fighting style with three distinct combat stances — Lion, Cheetah, and Rhino — each with its own rhythm and intent. Chain combos, unleash devastating STYLE attacks, and adapt to each fight with fluid precision.



MOVE WITH VELOCITY

Run walls, grind rails, and glide across rooftops in a world built for motion. Your parkour-infused maneuvers aren't just how you move – they're how you fight. Build momentum and turn it into a weapon.



CHANNEL YOUR LEGACY

Harness the Shiryoku, a mysterious force that lets you manipulate your environment. Pull debris, hurl projectiles, swing through the air, and reshape the battlefield to your advantage.



CLAIM YOUR FUTURE

Explore the vibrant districts of N10N-KOKU — a futuristic nation pulsing with global culture, anime-inspired style, and high-stakes conflict. Face rival clans, bond with your teammates, and fight for a future built on rhythm, rebellion, and legacy.

reviews:

GamesRadar+

“If you want to support an indie studio that admires Japanese culture … you should add the game to your wishlist now”
